description: Sends Colin Wynd an email from the user (for example a speaking invitation or a professional inquiry), with the user's email address as the reply-to. Works in two calls: without confirmation_code it sends nothing and returns a preview plus a code; with the same fields and that code, after the user has approved the preview, it sends the message. Colin Wynd's own address is never returned.

confirmation_code.description: Code from the preview step; include only after the user has confirmed

message.description: The message, written or approved by the user

organization.description: The user's company or organization, if any

reply_email.description: Email address where the user wants the reply

name: request_contact
title: Send Colin Wynd a message
